scope.source: Current canonical PRODUCTION ReceivablesImpact from OVERDUE_RECEIVABLES_1
scope.assessed_on: Equal to current canonical receivables as_of; all evidence observed_on <= assessed_on
scope.complete_coverage: Exactly the qualified Impact invoice population; no omitted or extra invoice/customer keys
scope.partial_coverage: Missing reviews remain UNRESOLVED; no extrapolation

current_population_fields.invoice_id: Stable original invoice identity in the qualified source Impact
current_population_fields.customer_id: Stable exact customer identity, not a customer class or cohort label
current_population_fields.outstanding: Positive exact Decimal GBP string from source Impact, never caller-supplied Opportunity value
current_population_fields.terms.days: Governed nonnegative integral contractual terms; missing terms cannot qualify capture
current_population_fields.days_overdue: Positive source-governed ageing at assessment date
current_population_fields.authority_evidence: Dated reference with explicit SOURCE_RECORD, MANAGEMENT_ASSERTION or HUMAN_FD_JUDGEMENT authority; observed_on must equal assessment date for assessment eligibility
current_population_fields.contacts: Dated CONTACTED/ACKNOWLEDGED/PROMISE_RECEIVED/NO_RESPONSE evidence; promised_on and promised_amount optional, never substituted for received cash
current_population_fields.constraint_basis: Explicit evidence of strategic restriction; does not change source Impact or label debt unrecoverable

positive_requirements.initiative_review: Explicit dated review covering this current invoice and relevant existing recovery activity; observed_on equals assessed_on

incrementality.existing_initiative: ALREADY_UNDERWAY with initiative_id, dated review and initiative_started_on < assessed_on is excluded from newly claimed value
incrementality.absence: Missing row, partial register, absent date or incomplete review remains UNKNOWN; never default to NONE

cohort.comparability_basis: Explicit source declaration, nonempty, retaining inclusion denominator and inception membership
cohort.eligible_pair_count: Exactly equal to number of supplied pairs
cohort.selection: No outcome-selected subset, successful-only sample, silently omitted pair or discarded contradictory outcome

exact_matches_for_both_arms.exposure: current.outstanding, exact Decimal equality; no scaling, tolerance or common-size fraction

cohort.treated_intervention: current review addressability: ORDINARY_COLLECTION or COMMERCIAL_INTERVENTION
cohort.paired_dates: Both arms have identical started_on and observed_through; closed on or before assessed_on
cohort.historical_identity: Every customer_id/invoice_id key unique within the current invoice's cohort, distinct from the current invoice; episode_id alone is not invoice_id
cohort.days_to_pay: Optional; if supplied requires original invoice_date, settled_on and exact date difference
cohort.contradiction: Any treated cash_received < comparison cash_received refuses the whole current invoice capture cohort

calculation.central: Exact unweighted arithmetic mean of all pair differences, only if rational denominator in lowest terms has no primes other than 2 and 5
central_absent: any contributing portion has no central estimate
calculation.invoice_aggregation: Sum disjoint qualified current-invoice low and high values; central only if every contributor has central; excluded and unresolved invoices contribute no invented value
calculation.all_zero: No positive Opportunity; zero historical uplift is not changed into a positive estimate
calculation.interpretation: Empirical prospective incremental CASH envelope, not a probability, confidence interval, guaranteed recovery, profit or realised benefit

workbook_transport.TABLES: CollectionWorkbook(): seven registered extract sheets with exact headers in intake/collection.py; incomplete history and initiative declarations are retained without promotion
workbook_transport.NORMALIZED: CollectionWorkbook(layout='NORMALIZED'): Collection Document!A4 = Collection document; A5 = one CE-2.50.1 JSON document; all other data columns/rows refused
workbook_transport.core_pack: Original seven accounting sheets plus six ReceivablesWorkbook sheets plus exactly the selected collection-provider sheet set; no unregistered extras
workbook_transport.amount_encoding: JSON financial numbers as Decimal-safe strings
workbook_transport.runtime_binding: client/run/Impact identities bind to the actually ingested canonical source; dataset_version_id is assigned by ingestion, never an invented source valuation
workbook_transport.retention: Immutable original workbook and normalized CSV, workbook hash/file ID/provider/source-version envelope, dated evidence references and source locators
